newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIAN RENKAAT SEES GOOD 97 EARNINGS TREND.
newsitem.headline: NOKIAN RENKAAT SEES GOOD 97 EARNINGS TREND.

text.p: Finnish tyre maker Nokian Renkaat repeated on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to develop positively.
"The company expects the 1997 profits to develop positively as already indicated earlier," the company said in a statement with its January-April interim results.

The group reported first tertial profit before extraordinary items at 30.3 million markka, up eight percent from the 28.0 million markka posted in the year-ago period. In 1996, the group's profit before extras was 119.2 million markka.
"The outlook for the tyre market seems more positive than last year, despite heavy price competition," it said.

"It is believed that demand for heavy tyres in particular will increase as the amount of transportation increases, and the outlook for the forestry industry improves," it said. "No essential raw material price changes are expected."
It said the outlook for new summer tyre sales looked good for the end of the season, and the Hakkapeliitta winter tyre product family would be expanded with new sizes in the autumn.
